{{Quote|Looks like I shall be rewarded…Ahsoka Tano!|audio=LooksLikeRewarded-Resolve.flac|The Eleventh Brother|<ref name="Resolve" />}}
The '''Eleventh Brother''', nicknamed "'''the Crow'''," was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Gender|male]] individual who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as [[Brother (Inquisitorius)|part]] of its [[Jedi hunter|Jedi-hunting]] [[Inquisitorius]]. Once a [[Jedi|member]] of the [[Jedi Order]], which [[Order 66|fell]] in [[19 BBY]], he became the Eleventh Brother shortly after and was present at the [[Inquisitor]]'s [[Fortress|base]] [[Fortress Inquisitorius]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[moon]] [[Nur]] where he met his Master, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]].

Between [[18 BBY]] and [[5 BBY]], the Empire was informed about the presence of a Jedi at a [[Unidentified farm village|farming village]], and the Eleventh Brother was [[Great Jedi Purge|dispatched]] to investigate. The Inquisitor [[Attack on a farm village|destroyed]] the [[City|village]] to lure out the Jedi, rounding up two survivors of the destruction, including the [[Unidentified village brother|individual]] who had tipped the Empire off. Shortly after, the supposed Jedi, actually former [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], returned to the village and prevented the Eleventh Brother from killing the informant [[Telekinesis|with]] [[the Force]]. Upon his realization the individual was Tano, the Inquisitor went to strike her down, but the former Jedi evaded his attacks before taking his [[Eleventh Brother's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and swiftly [[Death|killing]] him.

==Biography==
===Imperial Inquisitor===
{{Quote|Brothers, sisters. Enter.|The Grand Inquisitor, welcoming the Inquisitors|audio=BrothersSistersEnter-Devoted.flac|<ref name="Devoted" />}}
[[File:BrothersSistersKneel-Devoted.png|thumb|left|300px|The Eleventh Brother, First Brother, Barriss Offee, and Fourth Sister kneel before the Grand Inquisitor and Darth Vader.]]
A [[Force-sensitive]] [[humanoid]], the individual who would later be known as the Eleventh Brother<ref name="Countdown" /> and nicknamed "the Crow,"<ref name="TheCrow">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-maul-shadow-lord-trailer|text=Watch the Official Trailer for ''Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord''|date=2026-03-16}}</ref> was once a [[Jedi]] of the [[Jedi Order]].<ref name="Countdown" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="19BBY">The events of "[[Devoted]]" take place during and immediately after [[Operation: Knightfall]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]].</ref> the Jedi Order was [[Order 66|eliminated]]<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> and the individual was no longer a Jedi.<ref name="Countdown" /> That [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="19BBY" /> he<ref name="Companion" /> was present in the partially constructed [[Fortress Inquisitorius]]<ref name="Devoted" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[moon]] [[Nur]].<ref name="SWE" /> Now the Eleventh [[Brother (Inquisitorius)|Brother]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s<ref name="Devoted" /> [[Jedi hunter|Jedi-hunting]]<ref name="SWE" /> [[Inquisitorius]], he accompanied the [[Marrok|First Brother]] and [[Fourth Sister]] through a hallway flanked with [[Purge Trooper]]s into the [[fortress]]'s [[Fortress Inquisitorius audience chamber|audience chamber]] after being welcomed in by [[the Grand Inquisitor]],<ref name="Devoted" /> the leader of the [[Inquisitor]]s.<ref name="SWE" />

Within the audience chamber, the group joined fellow Inquisitor [[Barriss Offee]]. At the [[Grand Inquisitor]]'s command, the First Brother and Eleventh Brother took a [[Limb|knee]], with the Fourth [[Sister (Inquisitorius)|Sister]] and Offee following suit. The Grand Inquisitor then ushered in<ref name="Devoted" /> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]]<ref name="SWE" /> [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], the Inquisitors' new Master. After<ref name="Devoted" /> he<ref name="SWE" /> took his [[throne]], the Grand Inquisitor ordered those gathered to stand and declared "[[Long live the Empire]]."<ref name="Devoted" />

===Hunting a Jedi===
{{Quote|You claim a Jedi was here, and yet, I find no one.|The Eleventh Brother, to the informant|audio=YouClaim-Resolve.flac|<ref name="Resolve" />}}
[[File:AttackOnFarmVillage-Resolve.png|thumb|right|300px|The Eleventh Brother holds two hostages in the burning village.]]
Sometime between [[18 BBY]] and [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Death" /> the Eleventh Brother was [[Great Jedi Purge|dispatched]] to a remote<ref name="Who">{{SW|url=news/who-is-ahsoka-tano|text=Who Is Ahsoka Tano?|author=[[Kelly Knox|Knox, Kelly]]|date=2023-08-15}}</ref> [[Unidentified farm village|farming village]]<ref name="Who">{{SW|url=news/who-is-ahsoka-tano|text=Who Is Ahsoka Tano?|author=[[Kelly Knox|Knox, Kelly]]|date=2023-08-15}}</ref> on an [[Unidentified astronomical object (Ahsoka Tano)|astronomical object]] to investigate a tip from an [[Unidentified village brother|informant]] about the presence of a Jedi there. He [[Death|killed]] most of the inhabitants of the [[City|village]] and,<ref name="SWE" /> in order to find the Jedi, [[Attack on a farm village|burned]] the village;<ref name="Who" /> however, no Jedi came. Believing he had been lied to, the Eleventh Brother rounded up the survivors—the informant and an [[Unidentified old man (Ahsoka Tano)|old man]]—and held them within the burning village.<ref name="Resolve" />

The Eleventh Brother dragged his [[Eleventh Brother's lightsaber|lightsaber]] through the dirt as he paced near the two hostages before raising it to the informant's neck. He then confronted the informant about his information, stating that while he had claimed a Jedi had been at the village, he had found there was none. In response, the [[Gender|boy]] promised the Inquisitor a Jedi would arrive back at the village, and added that he should be rewarded for turning her in. The Eleventh Brother then asked the informant if he expected to be rewarded by the Empire despite lying, to which<ref name="Resolve" /> former [[Padawan]]<ref name="SWE" /> [[Ahsoka Tano]], the supposed Jedi in question, made her presence known by affirming the boy's claim.<ref name="Resolve" />

===Facing Ahsoka Tano===
{{Quote|And who might you be?|The Eleventh Brother, to Ahsoka Tano|audio=AndWhoMightYouBe-Resolve.flac|<ref name="Resolve" />}}
Turning to face Tano as she strode toward him, the Eleventh Brother inquired as to who she was, but she simply told him to let the hostages go. The boy then called out that she was the Jedi he had reported, and reminded the Inquisitor of his earlier statement that she would return to the village, which the Eleventh Brother agreed with. Walking behind the informant, the Inquisitor told him he would have his reward and then raised his [[Double-bladed spinning lightsaber|lightsaber]] to strike down the boy, but was thwarted by Tano's [[Telekinesis|use]] of [[the Force]].<ref name="Resolve" /> Immediately recognizing that it was Tano,<ref name="Highlights">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-tales-of-the-jedi-highlights|text=15 Highlights from ''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi''|author=[[Brandon Wainerdi|Wainerdi, Brandon]]|date=2022-12-02}}</ref> the Eleventh Brother walked toward her while igniting the second blade of his [[Double-bladed lightsaber|weapon]] and told the former Padawan she was supposed to be dead.<ref name="Resolve" />

[[File:EleventhBrotherDeflates-Resolve.gif|thumb|left|300px|The Eleventh Brother's helmet deflates after he is decapitated.]]
As he drew closer to Tano, the Inquisitor noted that he would be the one rewarded after all, and then stated her name. The Inquisitor struck at Tano with both blades, but the former Jedi avoided each attack. On the fourth swing, Tano grabbed the [[lightsaber]] and deactivated it, before taking the [[Weapon|lightsaber]] from his hands by kicking the Inquisitor's chest, separating the two. As the Eleventh Brother staggered back, she reactivated the saber and decapitated the Imperial. His [[helmet]] rolled back and deflated as his [[Color|red]] [[eye]]s went dark and his body collapsed.<ref name="Resolve" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You lie to me and expect Imperial favor?|The Eleventh Brother intimidates his hostage|audio=ImperialFavor-Resolve.flac|<ref name="Resolve" />}}
[[File:EleventhBrotherThreatens-Resolve.png|thumb|right|300px|The Eleventh Brother threatens the young man with his lightsaber.]]
The Eleventh Brother was a humanoid male<ref name="Countdown" /> with red eyes. The Inquisitor was ruthless, burning down an entire village and killing most of its inhabitants after receiving a tip that a Jedi was hiding among them.<ref name="Resolve" /> When he was unable to find the Jedi, he was frustrated<ref name="Highlights" /> and accused the informant of lying, threatening him with his lightsaber. After Tano revealed herself to him, he still planned to kill the informant. Upon realizing the supposed Jedi was Tano, he was<ref name="Resolve" /> eager to kill her,<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Finest Star Wars|cardname=Inquisitor|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/394545/cid/23204404}}</ref> expecting a reward for himself.<ref name="Resolve" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a former member of the Jedi Order, the Eleventh Brother was Force-sensitive and trained to [[Force power|wield]] the Force.<ref name="Countdown" /> He was also capable of wielding a lightsaber.<ref name="Resolve" />

==Equipment==
{{Listen3|EleventhBrothersSabersSecondBlade-Resolve.flac|the Eleventh Brother igniting his lightsaber's second blade}}
The Eleventh Brother wore a black helmet<ref name="DevotedAD">{{TOTE|Devoted}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> with a white, [[demon]]ic, [[bird]]-like mask.<ref name="Countdown" /> He wore a black [[cape]] with a silver clasp in the front. Both shoulders of the cape were adorned with a large [[Imperial crest]]. The Inquisitor wielded a double-bladed spinning lightsaber with red blades. He wore black clothes under his cape, with a black [[utility belt]] and black [[boot]]s. The Eleventh Brother's black [[glove]]s featured imagery of [[bone]]s along the fingers and talons at the tips.<ref name="Resolve" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Milestones===
{{Quote|There was miscommunication and we got the number wrong in the Encyclopedia.|Leland Chee, on the Eleventh Brother's entry in the ''Star Wars Encyclopedia''|<ref name="Discord">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2024-11-21|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1309008181808336926|quote=There was miscommunication and we got the number wrong in the Encyclopedia.|archivefile=File:LelandChee-Inquisitor-Discord.png}}</ref>}}
[[File:Resolve-Poster.png|thumb|right|250px|The Eleventh Brother first appeared in "Resolve."]]
The Eleventh Brother first appeared in "[[Resolve (episode)|Resolve]],"<ref name="Resolve" /> the sixth episode of [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (television series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']],<ref name="Companion" /> the first installment of ''[[Tales]]'', a [[Disney+]] animated anthology series.<ref name="Anthology">{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-underworld-announce|text=Two Favorite ''Star Wars'' Bounty Hunters are Back for ''Tales of the Underworld''|date=2025-04-02}}</ref> He was voiced by [[Clancy Brown]] and credited as "Inquisitor" in the episode,<ref name="Resolve" /> which released on [[October 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Companion" /> The Inquisitor was first previewed earlier in the year in a trailer shown at the ''Tales of the Jedi'' panel on [[May 28]] at [[Celebration Anaheim (2022)|Celebration Anaheim]]<ref name="Preview">{{WebCite|url=https://www.slashfilm.com/878206/liam-neeson-will-return-to-voice-qui-gon-jinn-in-star-wars-tales-of-the-jedi|text=Liam Neeson Will Return To Voice Qui-Gon Jinn In Star Wars: Tales Of The Jedi|archivedate=20220529002210|author=Cao, Caroline|date=2022-05-28}}</ref> before it was made publicly available on [[September 10]], 2022.<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|-uRRKqQbmw4|Tales Of The Jedi | Official Trailer | Disney Plus|sw_url=video/tales-of-the-jedi-official-trailer-disney|date=2022-09-10}}</ref> Concept art of the Eleventh Brother facing Ahsoka Tano before their duel was shown during the panel, as well.<ref name="ConceptArt">{{WebCite|url=https://thedirect.com/article/star-wars-jedi-disney-show|text=Star Wars Announces New Jedi Disney+ Show Coming This Year|author=Hargrave, Sam|date=2022-05-29|work=[https://thedirect.com The Direct]|archivedate=20220528222143}}</ref>

episode,<ref name="Resolve" /> created concept art of the Inquisitor.<ref name="Chris" /> A track on the series' [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (Original Soundtrack)|soundtrack]]—which was composed by [[Kevin Kiner]]<ref name="Soundtrack">{{OST|Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (Original Soundtrack)}}</ref> and released on October 26, 2022<ref name="Soundtrack release respectively.<ref name="Anthology" /> ''Tales of the Empire'' released [[May 4]], [[2024]]<ref name="EmpireRelease">{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-empire-trailer|text=''Star Wars: Tales of the Empire'' I hope your favorite one made the cut! If not, I'll do my best for the 30th! 🥰 #StarWars|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/FZ3g9|archivefile=File:GregoryVerreault-20thPoster-Twitter.png}}</ref> animator [[Gregory Verreault]]<ref name="Devoted" /> and given to attendees of the Lucasfilm Animation panel at [[Celebration Japan (2025)|Celebration Japan]] on [[April 18]], 2025.<ref name="PosterDate">{{WebCite|url=https://theholofiles.com/2025/04/18/dave-filoni-looks-back-at-20-years-of-lucasfilm-animation-at-celebration-japan|text=Dave Filoni Looks Back At 20 Years of Lucasfilm Animation at Celebration Japan|author=Bate, George; Bate, Josh|date=2025-04-18|work=[https://theholofiles.com The HoloFiles]|archivedate=20250419143310}}</ref> A sketch of the Inquisitor from<ref name="Sketch">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-san-diego-comic-con-ahsoka-season-2-first-look|text=Never-Before-Seen Art Celebrates 20 Years of Lucasfilm Animation at San Diego Comic-Con 2025|date=2025-07-24}}</ref> ''Tales of the Jedi''{{'s}} supervising director<ref name="TOTJ Is Here">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-tales-of-the-jedi-is-here|text=''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'' Is Here!|date=2022-10-26}}</ref> [[Dave Filoni]]'s sketchbook was shared at an exhibit celebrating Lucasfilm Animation's twentieth anniversary at San Diego Comic-Con 2025. The exhibit was available from [[July 24]] to [[July 27]], 2025.<ref name="Sketch" />

[[File:EleventhBrother-TalesOfTheEmpireIntro.png|thumb|left|250px|The Eleventh Brother as depicted in the opening sequence for ''Star Wars: Tales of the Empire'']]
The reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''<ref name="SWE" />—which was published on [[November 19]], 2024<ref name="SWERelease">{{DK|url=us/book/9780744098846-star-wars-encyclopedia|text=Star Wars Encyclopedia}}</ref>—identified the Inquisitor as the "First Brother."<ref name="SWE" /> However, two [[November 21|days]] later, the Inquisitor Marrok's entry on [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] was updated to identify Marrok as the "First Brother."<ref name="MarrokDB">{{Databank|marrok-inquisitor|Marrok (Inquisitor)|oldversion=20241121022413}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member and maintainer of the [[Holocron continuity database]]<ref name="LinkedIn">{{LinkedIn|url=in/holocron|text=Leland Chee|archiveurl=https://archive.is/byVHT}}</ref> [[Leland Chee]] confirmed the attribution of the title to the Eleventh Brother in the ''Encyclopedia'' was an error.<ref name="Discord" /> The Inquisitor was finally identified as the "Eleventh Brother" in "[[Inquisitor Countdown]]," an article authored by [[Amy Richau]] in the [[Star Wars Insider 229|229th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Countdown" /> which was released on [[December 10]], 2024.<ref name="229Release">{{TitanComics|url=m/171-star-wars-insider-229|text=Star Wars Insider #229}}</ref>

===Eleven is greater than six===
{{Quote|It's based on the same outline I gave publishing for the novel. It was always the same story.|Dave Filoni, on "Resolve"|<ref name="Nerdist">{{WebCite|url=https://nerdist.com/article/tales-of-the-jedi-dave-filoni-interview-ahsoka-tano-count-dooku-star-wars|text=Dave Filoni on How TALES OF THE JEDI Explores Choices Between Light and Dark|author=[[Amy Ratcliffe|Ratcliffe, Amy]]|date=2022-10-26|work=[[Wikipedia:Nerdist|Nerdist]]|archivedate=20221026155354}}</ref>}}
The [[2016]] young-adult novel [[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']], which was written by [[E. K. Johnston]], features Ahsoka Tano battling and killing an Inquisitor known as the [[Sixth Brother]] during an [[Raada Uprising|uprising]] on the Outer Rim moon [[Raada]].<ref name="Ahsoka">[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']]</ref> After Johnston watched the ''Tales of the Jedi'' trailer, she assumed the Inquisitor—at that point not identified—was new and therefore not an adaption of the Sixth Brother,<ref name="EK tweet 1">{{Twitter|username=ek_johnston|url=status/1568673474046226432|name=[[E. K. Johnston]]|date=2022-09-10|quote=A new Inquisitor, because it's only fair that Ahsoka gets to beat like 12 of them. 🤣🤣🤣|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/2JkCp|archivefile=File:EKJohnston-EleventhBrother-Twitter.png|nolive=1}}</ref> stating the individual he was seen threatening was not [[Kaeden Larte]],<ref name="EK tweet 2">{{Twitter|username=ek_johnston|url=status/1568675342424096768|name=[[E. K. Johnston]]|date=2022-09-10|quote=Well, that's certainly not Kaedan he's got.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/5fRvM|archivefile=File:EKJohnston-EleventhBrother-Twitter.png|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: So totally new Inquisitor and not a redesign of the Sixth Brother?}}</ref> a character from her ''Ahsoka'' novel.<ref name="Ahsoka" /> When a fan replied that the Inquisitor in the trailer seemed like the Sixth Brother, she replied that she appreciated their optimism.<ref name="EK tweet 3">{{Twitter|username=ek_johnston|url=status/1568748377474740225|name=[[E. K. Johnston]]|date=2022-09-10|quote=I like your optimism.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/NuQQT|archivefile=File:EKJohnston-EleventhBrother-Twitter.png|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: I don’t think this guy is a new inquisitor. He seemed like the one from your novel tbh}}</ref>

[[File:DaveFiloni-CelebrationEurope23.png|thumb|right|250px|According to Dave Filoni, "Resolve" was intended to be the same story as the ''Ahsoka'' novel.]]
When Johnston addressed the possibility of contradictions between her novel and ''Tales of the Jedi'', she noted her frustration upon seeing fans declare her novel non-[[canon]], stating that Dave Filoni had approved the novel years before and had since continued to work on her story.<ref name="EK contradictions tweet">{{Twitter|username=ek_johnston|url=status/1553725660459417602|name=[[E. K. Johnston]]|date=2022-07-31|quote=There isn't a big conspiracy behind the changes in Ahsoka's story. Dave approved the book six years ago and then kept working on her journey. It's frustrating to see people gleefully declare my book non-canon instead of just…using their imaginations. Like we did.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/YNtZn|archivefile=File:EKJohnston-TalesOfTheJedi-Twitter.png|nolive=1}}</ref> After the release of ''Tales of the Jedi'', Filoni confirmed that the episode was based on the same outline provided for the ''Ahsoka'' novel, and that it was intended to be the same story.<ref name="Nerdist" /> Both ''Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy'' and "Inquisitor Countdown" separate the two Inquisitors, though neither source states that the Sixth Brother was killed by Tano.<ref name="Countdown" /><ref name="SWE" /> This article assumes the events of ''Ahsoka'' and "Resolve" are separate.
